en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Sinan, from Ibrahim Bin Mihzam, from Anbasa Bin Bajad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Never was a meal presented to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> in which were dates, except that he<sup>saww</sup> began with the dates’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from his father from ibn Sinan from Ibrahim ibn Mehzam from ‘ Anbasah ibn Bijad who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whenever food was brought to the Messenger of Allah in which there were dates, he began with dates.’”
